Work carried out at GMG Head Office – CCTV control room.

Scope of Work – Dahua NVD Installation and Configuration
1. Supply and installation of Dahua Network Video Decoder (NVD).
2. Configuration and commissioning of the NVD device.
3. Supply and installation of HDMI cables for video connectivity.
4. Supply and installation of DVI-to-HDMI adapters for display interfacing.
5. Testing and verification of video output and connectivity to ensure proper operation.
